title: Make CreatureRig.Build transactional (preserve previous valid rig on failure)
description:
## Summary

`CreatureRig.Build` clears the current rig before validating and constructing (Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Animation/CreatureRig.cs:23-44). A failure after the previous rig is cleared leaves the component without a valid rig. Duplicate/missing-parent/null-bone validation already moved into `SkeletonSnapshot.Capture` (SkeletonSnapshot.cs:64-94) and now precedes GameObject creation, so the "reject before mutation" half is done under TSK-0073; the remaining gap is that a previous valid rig is destroyed before the new build is known to succeed. Also `CreatureRig.cs:33` `_bones.ContainsKey` duplicate check is now redundant (Capture guarantees uniqueness).

Source: docs/audits/creaturecreator-latest-main-audit-26-09-05-01-40-00.md, F-01. Re-verified at HEAD 2a89605; residual confirmed.

## Scope

- Capture and validate the complete skeleton BEFORE destroying the current rig.
- Build the new hierarchy against the snapshot; only swap in / destroy the old rig after the new hierarchy succeeds.
- On failure, preserve the previous valid rig (do not leave a null/partial state that a later ApplyPose sees as valid).
- Remove the now-redundant `_bones.ContainsKey` duplicate guard at CreatureRig.cs:33 (Capture already throws on duplicates).
- Do not redesign the rig or introduce interfaces.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A failed build (e.g. a rigged hierarchy that fails mid-construction) leaves the previously built rig intact and usable by ApplyPose.
- Duplicate-ID, missing-parent, null-bone, and empty-ID inputs are rejected before the old rig is touched.
- Successful rebuild after a prior failure works.
- The redundant duplicate check is removed without behavior change.

## Validation

- Focused `CreatureRig` PlayMode tests: duplicate ID, missing parent, failure after one valid node, and successful rebuild after failure.
- `dotnet build` Runtime + Tests.Runtime pass 0 errors/warnings.
- Existing rig/pose suite stays green.

## Findings

- F-01 partial at HEAD: validation-before-creation satisfied via SkeletonSnapshot.Capture; "preserve previous valid rig" residual open because Clear() runs before Capture.

## Blockers

- None identified. Related to TSK-0073 (CC-069 rig & pose).

## Next Step

- Reorder Build to capture/validate first, build-new-hierarchy, then swap/destroy old rig; remove the redundant dup guard; add the PlayMode failure tests.
